thread:
zoe-sales: Quick sync — HelixMed POC tomorrow. Procurement wants to know if we can accept a pre-PO so ops can spin up EU Dedicated sandbox, and whether the DPA redlines are acceptable before signature. Need legal + security ok.

omar-ps: Tech note: 2-week Dedicated trial, expected load light. EU residency required. Ops needs a PO reference to start sandbox.

megan-procurement: Customer prefers PO before provisioning. We'll accept a pre-PO that says "Subject to contract" and includes the PO number. They asked for Net60.

ravi-legal: We can accept pre-PO for provisioning only. Will prepare minimal DPA redline and an Order Form proviso: "Order Form provisioning permitted upon receipt of a PO marked 'Subject to contract'. Full enforceability contingent on executed MSA."

claire-security: SOC2 link: https://redwood-infer-soc2.example/helixmed.pdf. We support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated. Pen test summary available on request.

zoe-sales: Please drop the redline and exact signer names for DocuSign. Customer signer order: Exec -> Finance -> Legal. They want backup signer for Finance.

docusign-bot: Created envelope 5160001150 for MSA + DPA + Order Form. Status: drafted.

megan-procurement: We'll map PO to invoice field PO_REF. Pre-PO acceptable with "Subject to contract" language. Net60 noted.

ravi-legal: Redline uploaded to envelope 5160001150 (minor subprocessor notice tweak). I'll sign as "Ravi Patel (Redwood Legal)".

omarr-ps: Ops lead time: sandbox ready within 48 hours of pre-PO; production requires signed MSA (5 business days).

zoe-sales: Action items: 1) @ravi-legal finalize DocuSign (in progress). 2) @claire-security attach pen test summary (done). 3) @megan-procurement confirm PO_REF mapping (done). I'll send the pre-PO template to HelixMed now.

megan-procurement: Customer replied they will issue pre-PO this afternoon. Moving to provision once envelope has docuSign id.

zoe-sales: Great — closing after sign-off. Thanks all.
